mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMUNITY_POST_ID AS communityPostId, C.COMMUNITY_TITLE_ AS communityTitle, C.USER_ID AS userId, --닉네임 없으면 탈퇴한 회원 NVL(U.USER_NICKNAME, '탈퇴한 회원') AS userNickname, U.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, C.COMMUNITY_VIEW_COUNT AS communityViewCount, C.COMMUNITY_LIKE_COUNT AS communityLikeCount, --이미지가 있으면 API URL 생성, 없으면 NULL CASE WHEN C.COMMUNITY_IMAGE_DATA IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/community/image/' || C.COMMUNITY_POST_ID ELSE NULL END AS communityImagePath FROM TB_COMMUNITY C LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ORDER BY community_post_id DESC
